justification: Both depict human or humanlike figures, but A is a densely packed low-relief panel of small seated/standing figures interleaved with columns of block-like glyph signs, while B is a single massive frontal figure in the round with a schematic oversized head, brow ridge, nose, ears, headdress-like block, and a plain torso with nipples and arms held to the sides. Beyond the universal fact of a human form, there is no shared motif, relationship or compositional scheme; the depiction conventions (crowded narrative relief with script vs isolated monolithic frontal body) are wholly different.
